findings.issue: phase-2 fix U1 is not met on screen 'dashboard_populated': Screen title ("Receipts"): Title renders at ~40px display size, flush to the very top with no safe-area inset, so it is visually clipped and overpowers the content; desktop shows no top padding either. Expected after the fix: Create src/components/ui/ScreenHeader.tsx used by every screen: <View style={{paddingTop: insets.top + 16, paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingBottom: 16}}><Text variant="headlineMedium">{title}</Text></View> using useSafeAreaInsets(); remove per-screen title styles. Seen in the screenshot: The screen title "Dashboard" is flush to the very top of the screen, visually clipped and overpowering the content, which violates the requirement that it should have top padding and not be flush to the top.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: phase-2 fix U2 is not met on screen 'receipts_loaded': Receipt card body: Four stacked lines of near-identical bodyLarge text with "Date:"/"Category:" prefixes; no visual hierarchy, card is taller than it needs to be. Expected after the fix: Restructure ReceiptCard content to: row 1 = amount Text variant="titleLarge" (left) + type Chip (right); row 2 = Text variant="bodySmall" color onSurfaceVariant with "2026-11-12 · Supplies" (drop the label prefixes); row 3 = note Text variant="bodyMedium" onSurfaceVariant. Card padding 16, gap 4 between rows. Seen in the screenshot: The receipt card body shows four stacked lines of text with "Date:" and "Category:" prefixes, which violates the requirement to drop these prefixes. The current layout also includes a note line ("Office supplies", "Client dinner") and a photo attachment line, which do not match the expected structur
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: phase-2 fix U3 is not met on screen 'receipts_loaded': "Expense" label: Plain teal primary-colored text looks like a tappable link and competes with the amount. Expected after the fix: Replace with <Chip compact mode="flat" textStyle={{fontSize:12}} style={{backgroundColor: theme.colors.secondaryContainer}}>Expense</Chip> with onSecondaryContainer text; never use colors.primary for non-interactive labels. Seen in the screenshot: The 'Expense' label is rendered in teal primary-colored text that looks like a tappable link, competing with the amount. It does not match the expected design which requires it to be displayed as a Chip with onSecondaryContainer text and backgroundColor: theme.colors.secondaryContainer.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: phase-2 fix U4 is not met on screen 'receipts_loaded': "[photo attached]" text: Bracketed italic placeholder text reads as debug output and uses primary color. Expected after the fix: Replace with a row: <Icon source="paperclip" size={16} color={theme.colors.onSurfaceVariant} /> + Text variant="bodySmall" onSurfaceVariant "Photo attached", 8px gap, 8px top margin. Seen in the screenshot: The text '[photo attached]' is still visible in square brackets, which is the old debug placeholder text. The requirement expects it to be replaced with an icon and text 'Photo attached' in a specific format.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: phase-2 fix U5 is not met on screen 'receipts_loaded': Primary action: Large empty area below the two cards and no way to add a receipt from this screen, breaking the "always offer the next action" rule. Expected after the fix: Add Paper <FAB icon="plus" label="Add receipt" /> positioned absolute right:16, bottom: tabBarHeight + 16, and set list contentContainerStyle paddingBottom: 96 so the last card isn't covered. Seen in the screenshot: The screen shows a large empty area below the two cards, but there is no FAB (Floating Action Button) for adding a receipt as required. The requirement expects a Paper <FAB icon="plus" label="Add receipt" /> positioned absolute right:16, bottom: tabBarHeight + 16, which is absent in the screenshot.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: phase-2 fix U7 is not met on screen 'dashboard_populated': Card elevation / list spacing: Cards use a soft drop shadow on a grey background with inconsistent 16/24 gaps, giving a dated look. Expected after the fix: In theme.ts set Card default to mode="elevated" elevation={1} and roundness 3 (12px); in the list use ItemSeparatorComponent with height 16 and contentContainerStyle paddingTop 8 — remove ad-hoc card margins. Seen in the screenshot: The cards on the dashboard do not have a soft drop shadow or elevated appearance as specified in the requirement. They appear flat with no visible elevation or shadow, contradicting the expected design of mode="elevated" elevation={1} and roundness 3 (12px).
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: phase-2 fix U8 is not met on screen 'dashboard_populated': Bottom navigation labels: Active and inactive tabs are both colored teal-ish with no active indicator pill, so current location is unclear. Expected after the fix: Use Paper BottomNavigation.Bar styling: activeColor = colors.onSecondaryContainer with the pill indicator enabled, inactiveColor = colors.onSurfaceVariant, labels at labelMedium (12px), bar height 80 with safe-area bottom inset. Seen in the screenshot: The bottom bar shows Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage and Settings all in saturated teal/blue colored icons and labels with no grey inactive styling and no pill indicator behind the active 'Dashboard' tab, so the current tab is not distinguishable.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: task requirement R3 is not met on screen 'dashboard_populated': The "Receipt saved" confirmation must never cover the Recent activity list on a phone screen. Seen in the screenshot: The "Receipt saved" confirmation dialog is positioned directly above the "Recent activity" section, partially obscuring the top portion of the first activity item, which violates the requirement that it must never cover the Recent activity list.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: Placeholder and error text colors are hard‑coded hex values (e.g. "#6F6F6F", "#B00020") instead of using design‑token values from `theme.colors.placeholder` and `theme.colors.error`.
findings.fix: Replace all hard‑coded colour strings with references to the theme (e.g. `style={{ color: theme.colors.placeholder }}`) or the CSS custom properties (`var(--color-placeholder)`).

findings.issue: Disabled state does not set `aria-disabled="true"` and relies on visual dimming only; screen readers cannot reliably detect the disabled status.
findings.fix: Add `accessibilityState={{ disabled: true }}` (or `aria-disabled` on the underlying web element) and ensure the disabled colour comes from `theme.colors.disabled`.

findings.issue: The large FAB and its MiniFAB children lack `accessibilityLabel`/`accessibilityHint` and do not expose a focus‑visible outline on web/desktop, making keyboard navigation ambiguous.
findings.fix: Supply descriptive `accessibilityLabel` (e.g. "Add receipt") and `accessibilityHint` to each FAB, and add a focus‑visible style (2 dp outline using `theme.colors.outline`) via `onFocus`/`onBlur` or CSS `:focus-visible`.

findings.issue: Snackbar does not have an ARIA live region (`role="alert"`/`aria-live="assertive"`), so screen readers may not announce the success message promptly.
findings.fix: Add `accessibilityLiveRegion="assertive"` (or `role="alert"`) to the Snackbar component so the "Receipt saved" message is announced.

findings.issue: The full‑screen offline banner is rendered without an ARIA role or live region, so users of assistive technology may miss the notification.
findings.fix: Wrap the banner text in an element with `role="alert"` and `aria-live="assertive"` (or use Paper’s `Banner` component with proper accessibility props).

findings.issue: The scrollable content area lacks a landmark role (`role="main"`) and does not explicitly mark the screen heading as a header for a proper heading hierarchy.
findings.fix: Add `role="main"` to the `<ScrollView>` wrapper and ensure the top `<Text variant="headlineMedium">` has `accessibilityRole="header"` (or equivalent).

findings.issue: Dialog does not trap keyboard focus; users can tab to elements behind the dialog, breaking modal semantics.
findings.fix: Use Paper’s `<Dialog>` inside a `<Portal>` with `accessibilityViewIsModal={true}` or manually manage focus trapping with a focus‑trap library.

findings.issue: Bottom tab bar lacks explicit ARIA roles (`role="tablist"` for the container and `role="tab"` for each item) and does not announce selection state via `accessibilityState`.
findings.fix: Add `accessibilityRole="tablist"` to the navigation container and `accessibilityRole="tab"` plus `accessibilityState={{ selected: true }}` to each tab component.

findings.issue: Screen does not render a top‑level heading element, breaking the expected h1 hierarchy (one headline per screen).
findings.fix: Insert a `<Text variant="headlineMedium" accessibilityRole="header">Settings</Text>` at the top of the screen.

findings.issue: Missing top‑level heading (h1) for the screen, violating the heading hierarchy requirement.
findings.fix: Add a `<Text variant="headlineMedium" accessibilityRole="header">Categories</Text>` as the first element inside the screen.

findings.issue: The 'Accept' button is grayed out until the checkbox is checked, which is correct behavior, but the placeholder text 'Tick the box to continue.' is slightly redundant since the button state already communicates the requirement.
findings.fix: Remove or rephrase the placeholder text to avoid redundancy.

findings.issue: No primary action button (e.g., Save) visible. Users must infer the next step after filling out the form.
findings.fix: Add a prominent 'Save' button at the bottom of the form, aligned with the FAB pattern from the dashboard.

findings.issue: Form fields lack placeholder text or hints, making it unclear what data is expected (e.g., 'Amount' field).
findings.fix: Add placeholder text or inline hints (e.g., 'Enter amount in USD') to each field.

findings.issue: No error states or validation feedback shown for invalid inputs.
findings.fix: Implement inline validation with error messages (e.g., 'Amount required') when fields are empty or invalid.

findings.issue: Typography lacks a clear type scale; headings, labels, and body text are visually similar in weight and size.
findings.fix: Establish a type scale: use bold, larger font for headings; medium weight for section titles; regular for labels and body text.

findings.issue: Spacing between form sections and fields is inconsistent and too tight in places, reducing readability.
findings.fix: Apply consistent vertical spacing (e.g., 24dp) between sections and 16dp between fields. Add padding inside fields.

findings.issue: The 'Scan receipt' button is grayed out and appears inactive, but no visual indicator explains why it’s disabled (e.g., no photo uploaded).
findings.fix: Add a tooltip or inline message (e.g., 'Upload a photo to scan') when the button is disabled.

findings.issue: Form elements are not fully responsive; fields and buttons are aligned to the left edge, not centered or utilizing available space.
findings.fix: Center-align the form content or use a grid system to distribute elements evenly across the desktop viewport.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'receipt_entry' (target 8+, minimum 7): The screen is clean and functional, with clear visual hierarchy and a consistent layout. However, it lacks polish in typography, spacing, and form design, and misses key affordances like a primary action button or error states. It’s good enough for a first iteration but not yet polished for a commercial product.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: No primary action for adding a new receipt — the screen shows only existing receipts with no visible FAB or button to start a new entry, contradicting the design spec which requires a prominent FAB for adding receipts.
findings.fix: Add a floating action button (FAB) labeled 'Add Receipt' or similar, positioned prominently at the bottom right, matching the design spec’s requirement for always-visible primary actions.

findings.issue: Inconsistent spacing and alignment — cards are not uniformly spaced, and the text within cards is not aligned to a consistent grid. The 'Expense' label is right-aligned but not consistently positioned relative to the amount or other content.
findings.fix: Apply a consistent grid system: align cards to a vertical rhythm, center-align or left-align all text within cards, and ensure consistent padding and spacing between elements.

findings.issue: Desktop layout is stretched and underutilized — content is centered with no horizontal padding, leaving large empty space on the left and right. The bottom navigation bar is too narrow and doesn’t use the full width, appearing as if it’s a phone layout forced into a desktop viewport.
findings.fix: Use the desktop viewport to create a more spacious, balanced layout. Add horizontal padding to the content area, adjust card spacing, and expand the bottom navigation bar to full width with consistent spacing between icons.

findings.issue: No touch-friendly controls — the screen shows only cards and text, with no visible buttons or interactive elements for adding a receipt. The design spec requires a form with fields, but this screen appears to be a read-only list.
findings.fix: Add a visible 'Add Receipt' button or FAB at the bottom of the screen. Ensure the form fields (date, category, etc.) are present and clearly labeled when in the 'Add Receipt' state.

findings.issue: Typography lacks a type scale — all text appears to use the same font size and weight, with no hierarchy to distinguish titles, labels, or body text. The header 'Receipts' is large, but the rest is not scaled appropriately.
findings.fix: Implement a type scale: use larger font sizes for headers, medium for section titles, and smaller for body text and labels. Ensure consistent line height and letter spacing for readability.

findings.issue: visual quality 6/10 on 'receipts_loaded' (target 8+, minimum 7): The screen is functional and visually clean, but lacks the polish of a premium product. It's missing a clear primary action for adding a new receipt, has inconsistent spacing and alignment, and uses a basic layout that doesn't leverage the desktop viewport effectively. Typography is readable but not scaled or branded. It meets basic usability but doesn't feel like a product people would pay for.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: No visible primary action to save the receipt; user must infer the next step.
findings.fix: Add a prominent Save button at the bottom or top of the form, aligned with the FAB pattern from the dashboard.

findings.issue: Desktop layout lacks visual hierarchy for secondary actions; 'Additional information' section is visually secondary but not styled to indicate it.
findings.fix: Add subtle visual cues (e.g., lighter background, border, or spacing) to distinguish 'Additional information' from primary form fields.

findings.issue: Form fields are not touch-friendly; input fields are too narrow for thumbs to tap accurately.
findings.fix: Increase field width to 80% of screen width or add generous padding on all sides to improve tap targets.

findings.issue: No error states or helpful hints shown for form fields (e.g., 'Amount' field is empty but no placeholder or validation message).
findings.fix: Add placeholder text or inline validation messages for required fields to guide users.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'receipt_entry_photo' (target 8+, minimum 7): Polished, clean layout with clear visual hierarchy and consistent spacing. Primary action is obvious (Add photo). Typography is readable with a clear scale. Form fields are well-grouped and labeled. Desktop layout is spacious and not stretched. Minor issues: no visible save button, no error states shown, and desktop lacks visual hierarchy for secondary actions.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: The 'Receipt saved' snackbar overlaps with the 'Receipt' and 'Mileage' buttons, creating visual clutter and potential touch target interference.
findings.fix: Position the snackbar above the FABs or animate it to slide up and off-screen to avoid overlapping with interactive elements.

findings.issue: The 'Receipt saved' snackbar is visually indistinct from the 'Receipt' and 'Mileage' buttons due to similar rounded corners and dark blue color.
findings.fix: Use a distinct background color, border, or animation for the snackbar to clearly separate it from interactive buttons.

findings.issue: The 'Receipt saved' snackbar is positioned too close to the bottom edge, potentially causing it to be cut off or obscured by the browser window or OS taskbar.
findings.fix: Adjust the snackbar’s vertical position to ensure it remains fully visible on desktop, possibly by anchoring it to the top of the screen or using a fixed position with padding.

findings.issue: Typography lacks a clear type scale; heading and body text are similar in weight and scale, reducing visual hierarchy.
findings.fix: Use a distinct hierarchy: bold, larger heading for 'Mileage', smaller, lighter body text for metadata, and even smaller text for the description. Ensure consistent spacing between text elements.

findings.issue: The 'Mileage' card is centered but not aligned to a grid; spacing between card and buttons is inconsistent with the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Align the card to the left edge or center it within a grid. Ensure consistent padding and spacing between the card, buttons, and bottom navigation.

findings.issue: The card and buttons are centered on the page, leaving large empty space on the left and right sides, which feels unbalanced.
findings.fix: Left-align the card and buttons to the left edge. Use padding on the left and right to frame the content, or center the content within a container with consistent margins.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'mileage_empty' (target 8+, minimum 7): Polished, clean layout with clear visual hierarchy and consistent spacing. Primary action is obvious. Typography is readable but lacks a distinct type scale. Desktop layout is spacious and well-aligned. Touch targets are appropriately sized. No critical errors, but opportunities for refinement exist.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: The 'Save mileage' button is not large enough for optimal touch targeting; it should be at least 44x44pt minimum for single-handed use.
findings.fix: Increase button size to 56x56pt or add padding to ensure it's easily tappable.

findings.issue: The placeholder text 'YYYY-MM-DD' under the date field is not visually distinct from the input value, which could confuse users.
findings.fix: Use a lighter weight or smaller font for the placeholder, or add a subtle underline to indicate it's a hint.

findings.issue: The form fields and button are centered but lack visual alignment with the left edge, creating an unbalanced feel on desktop.
findings.fix: Align all form elements to the left edge for a more structured, professional layout on desktop.

findings.issue: The 'Receipt' and 'Mileage' buttons in the recent activity cards are slightly cramped and overlap with the card content, reducing readability.
findings.fix: Increase padding around the buttons or reduce button size to prevent overlap and improve readability.

findings.issue: The text 'Client dinner' and '[photo attached]' in the receipt card are too close to the bottom edge of the card, creating a visual imbalance.
findings.fix: Add padding at the bottom of the card to ensure consistent spacing and improve visual hierarchy.

findings.issue: The 'Mileage saved' snackbar is positioned too close to the right edge of the screen, which may appear misaligned with the card content.
findings.fix: Center the snackbar horizontally or adjust its position to align with the card content for better visual balance.

findings.issue: The typography lacks a real type scale: the title and buttons use the same font weight and size, creating visual hierarchy issues.
findings.fix: Apply a type scale: use a larger, bold font for the title, medium weight for section headers, and lighter weight for body text. Ensure button text is legible and consistent with platform standards.

findings.issue: Spacing between buttons is inconsistent and too tight, especially on desktop where it feels cramped.
findings.fix: Increase vertical spacing between buttons to 24–32px for desktop and 16–20px for mobile. Add padding to buttons for better touch targets.

findings.issue: The toggle switch for 'App lock' is visually unstyled and lacks feedback on state (e.g., no indicator when enabled).
findings.fix: Style the toggle with a clear on/off state, using color or iconography to indicate active status. Add a subtle animation or highlight when toggled.

findings.issue: The bottom navigation bar icons are generic and lack visual hierarchy or branding. The 'Settings' icon is identical to the screen title, which is confusing.
findings.fix: Use platform-standard icons or custom icons with clear visual distinction. Consider adding a subtle indicator (e.g., badge) to the active tab to reinforce context.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'settings' (target 8+, minimum 7): The Settings screen is clean, functional, and follows a consistent design language. It uses a clear vertical hierarchy, touch-friendly buttons, and a bottom navigation bar for context. However, it lacks visual polish and brand identity, and the typography and spacing feel generic and underdeveloped for a polished product.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: Typography lacks a clear type scale; headings and body text use similar weights and sizes, reducing visual hierarchy.
findings.fix: Establish a clear type scale: use a larger, bolder font for headings (e.g., 24pt), medium for section titles (e.g., 18pt), and smaller for body text (e.g., 14pt).

findings.issue: Desktop layout is too narrow; content is cramped and doesn't utilize available space effectively.
findings.fix: Expand card widths and increase spacing between cards to better utilize the 1280px width. Add padding to the left and right to avoid content hugging the edges.

findings.issue: The 'Rename' buttons are slightly too close to the category names, reducing readability.
findings.fix: Increase padding between the category name and the 'Rename' button to improve visual separation and readability.

findings.issue: Toggle switches are not consistently aligned; some are slightly offset within their containers.
findings.fix: Align all toggle switches to the right edge of their containers with consistent padding for uniform appearance.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'categories' (target 8+, minimum 7): Polished, modern interface with clear visual hierarchy and consistent spacing. The layout works well on both phone and desktop, with a clean grid and touch-friendly controls. Minor issues with typography and spacing consistency across devices.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: Top padding above 'Export data' header is slightly inconsistent with bottom padding below the buttons, creating a minor visual imbalance.
findings.fix: Adjust padding to ensure top and bottom spacing are symmetrical around the content block.

findings.issue: Primary action button 'Create backup' is greyed out and lacks visual emphasis, making it appear inactive despite being the only actionable element.
findings.fix: Apply a strong primary button style (e.g., solid fill, bold text, contrasting color) to clearly signal it as the main action. Ensure it’s enabled when valid input is provided.

findings.issue: Typography lacks a real type scale; heading and body text use similar weights and sizes, reducing visual hierarchy.
findings.fix: Use a proper type scale: bold, larger heading for 'Create backup'; smaller, lighter subheading for the instruction; even smaller body text for the validation message.

findings.issue: Form fields are too close to the top edge and lack sufficient padding above/below, reducing perceived breathing room.
findings.fix: Add consistent padding around the form elements (e.g., 16px top padding after header, 16px bottom padding before button) to create a more balanced layout.

findings.issue: The form is centered but lacks horizontal padding, causing elements to appear too tight against the left and right edges.
findings.fix: Apply consistent horizontal padding (e.g., 24px or 32px) to the form container to create a more spacious, desktop-friendly layout.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'backup_passphrase_modal' (target 8+, minimum 7): Polished, clean, and functional UI with clear hierarchy and consistent spacing. The form is well-structured and responsive across both viewports. However, the typography lacks a real type scale and the primary action button is visually muted, reducing its impact.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: The 'Restore from backup' button's text color is blue, which may not contrast well with the button's border and background in some contexts.
findings.fix: Use a more contrasting color for the button text, or ensure the button has sufficient background contrast to make the text readable.

summary: Phase 2 works through the fixed list of fixes taken when phase 1 finished; the other findings of that review are notes.
